    public static async ValueTask<int> PatchAsync(NpgsqlConnection connection, UserPatch patch, CancellationToken ct, NpgsqlTransaction? transaction = null, int? commandTimeout = null)
    {
        if (patch.Mask == 0UL) return 0;
        if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open) await connection.OpenAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

        await using var cmd = new NpgsqlCommand("", connection, transaction);
        if (commandTimeout.HasValue) cmd.CommandTimeout = commandTimeout.Value;

        var sb = new StringBuilder("UPDATE \"public\".\"Users\" SET ");
        var separator = "";
        
        if ((patch.Mask & (1UL << 0)) != 0) { sb.Append("\"Name\" = @Name"); separator = ", "; cmd.Parameters.Add(UserNpgsql.CreateParameterName((string)patch.NameValue!)); }
        if ((patch.Mask & (1UL << 1)) != 0) { sb.Append(separator + "\"Email\" = @Email"); separator = ", "; cmd.Parameters.Add(UserNpgsql.CreateParameterEmail((string)patch.EmailValue!)); }

        sb.Append(" WHERE \"Id\" = @Id");

        cmd.CommandText = sb.ToString();
        cmd.Parameters.Add(UserNpgsql.CreateParameterId(patch.Id));
        
        return await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
